title: a div-built slider seeks on press and follows a drag

interactions.name: a press seeks to where the reader pressed
the drag's motion reaches the page
the drag leaves the slider where the reader let go

interaction.reason: the seek works — a click carries its permille point — but the held drag has no path: press-move-release on a div thumb is left to the browser and nothing goes landside

notes: the click lands on #mark-10, a 1px tick at 10% whose centre maps to level 10 exactly; values quantised to tens so a pixel of cross-half layout difference cannot flap a check
